report_name: LOCAL CYCLING AND WALKING INFRASTRUCTURE PLAN Peterlee
how_pct_was_used: The Propensity to Cycle Tool (PCT) was used as a data source to inform the identification of desire lines and to assess the effectiveness of potential cycling routes within the prioritisation framework.
specific_evidence_of_impact: The LCWIP has been used to inform current funding opportunities, with early design work identifying routes and schemes that serve key desire lines and the town centre, and it will support the County Council in making the case for future funding.
pct_usage_quote: Forecast number of journeys to work using the corridor in the Government Target Near Market scenario (LSOA)
